title: Ids
description: Identifier types (CONTRACTS §3.2). Only the ids the seed schemas use (Q-CT-6); the rest land with their first user.

CommanderId.description: UUIDv7, canonical lowercase (IDENTITY §1). Not a platform id.

TaskingJobId.description: Tasking Board job id: per campaign, one counter for both sides' boards, never reused (GAMEPLAY §1b).

BlobId.description: A SIGINT blob, <refresh_tick>-<cell_index> (FOG-OF-WAR FOW-2). Opaque to clients.

CrewMarkerId.description: Per campaign, allocated by the kernel when a crew is downed, never reused (GAMEPLAY 6a, COMBAT CB-8).

NodeId.description: Stable slug from the theater file.

SectorId.description: Named map region from the theater file (OVERLAY AN-1).

CommandSeq.description: Arrival order assigned by the runtime inbox; carried as arrival_seq.
